verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n offers AI building blocks: LLM provider connections, agent nodes, and use-case examples such as "Generate customer insights from reviews." These let users construct their own insight-generating workflows. There is no evidence of a native, in-product feature that analyzes the user's data and surfaces AI insights or suggestions, so the support is only a developer-constructed capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
